text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The long-awaited Arima Kinen is here. Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond's dream of racing together in a G1 race is on the cusp of becoming reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, Tokai Teio's surprise entry has turned this race into the ultimate end-of-year festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her best friend and her idol. Kitasan Black's unforgettable dream race gets underway with a truly incomparable lineup of rivals!
